evidence_sentence: If the detected protocol is DCERPC over UDP, it proceeds to check other detection methods.
rationale: The vulnerable implementation immediately returns the first PM result whenever PM finds a match, including DCERPC over UDP. Only the fixed implementation special-cases UDP DCERPC, retains it as a fallback, and continues to PP/PE detection to avoid a misdetection. The quoted Logic sentence therefore specifically describes the fixed-only control flow.
rewritten_docstring: The function first checks if the flow has completed passive monitoring (PM). If not, it attempts to detect the protocol using PM methods. It then checks other applicable detection methods. If PM is complete, it checks for protocol detection using post-processing (PP) methods. Finally, it checks against an expectation list if the protocol is still unknown. The function returns the most specific protocol detected.
